dedupe_keys.name: kit battery ageing preparation and plausibility scripts

description: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology provides Python examples for preparing its battery-ageing measurements. The repository documents a minimal reading and plotting example, comparisons of capacity and impedance results, plausibility checks and a routine for generating resampled ageing logs. Configuration files define data paths, column labels and requested plots. Source access is public and free under MIT. The examples have coverage of the associated 228-cell NMC and silicon-anode experiment and can be adapted to compatible measurement tables. Prepared observations can calibrate degradation simulations and storage-lifetime assumptions in model-pypsa studies. A caveat is that labels are not complete for every published column and users must configure paths and resampling choices. Reduced logs can conceal short events relevant to ageing. No scripts or battery archives were executed.
